label: 2026-10-13-obs-quote-consumer
purpose: VERBATIM-QUOTE-OMISSION group C + CONTAINMENT-FIX-B consumer side: observability-config 1.8.0 -> 1.9.0 (C1 byte-for-byte file quoting, C2 Prometheus values rule, CONSUMED_ADDRESS_CLAUSE), DRAFT-C.md section 5 as REVISED by the model-evaluation gate review (cline_docs/reviews/verbatim-quote-omission-2026-10-13/LAB-PREREG-OBS.md section 2). ONE lever per arm: protocol text (hbase/hobs19 on Harvester nodes, base/obs19 on consumer nodes); models = production tiers (Harvester claude-sonnet-5, Author claude-opus-5-5 high, Reviewer claude-sonnet-5 high); templates = today's rows pinned. Harvester nodes: harvesterOnly, tools RECORDED (the production raw results, R9 by the shipping loop). A Harvester sample COUNTS only if >= 90% of its file-tool calls were served (recorded-tools.ts); invalid samples are reported and re-drawn into a second run folder for the shortfall (stop if > 15 invalid). SCORE: Harvester = scoreHarvesterQuotes (score-quote.ts: the shipping computeQuoteFidelity per block, plus a STRICT reading with a verbatim label prepended, because the stamped fact cannot see an unlabelled silent cut); consumer = markerPresence + parsed Consumed Values + offline check 1 + the lab's shipping leg net (derivationContainment). DO-NOT-SHIP (one hit stops all three edits): G-H-CORRUPT (a) pooled over the nodes with both arms (H-R2, H-R1, H-PROM; 20 variant vs 15 baseline samples): variant edited-line sample rate >= baseline rate + 15 points AND >= 3 variant samples; (b) H-CLEAN or H-PROMC: >= 2/5 variant samples with an edited line. G-H-SPUR: any marker heading (Harvested Allocations / Derived Values / Consumed Values) in any variant Harvester sample. G-H-OVER: any variant Harvester sample stopping at max_tokens, or >= 2 variant samples on one node longer than 2x that node's production finalResponse. G-H-PROMVAL (hand read, every H-PROM/H-PROMC variant sample): any quoted key or value the served rendering did not return. G-C-FAB: any consumed entry the sample's own artifact does not apply, or outside the upstream's published set (10.244.0.5, 10.244.0.6 on O-SEL/O-SEL1). G-C-SPUR: any Consumed Values block on O-DOC. G-C-SPLIT: any O-RANGE sample declaring the upstream range as anything but that one range (offline check 1 vs the stored upstream must be []). G-C-AGG: any O-SEL/O-SEL1 entry that joins or aggregates addresses (offline check 1 vs S1 = 10.244.0.5/32,10.244.0.6/32 must be []). SHIP GATES (all must hold; a miss => revise the named text and rerun only the named cells): G-H-FAITH: H-R2 + H-R1 hobs19 >= 13/15 FAITHFUL (score: >= 1 file block and every file block strict-clean), H-R2 alone >= 9/10; hbase rate recorded and stated beside it with both n (a variant rate not above the hbase rate is a miss). G-H-ADD (moved from do-not-ship: it is C1's target, not a harm): file-lane variant samples (H-R2, H-R1, H-CLEAN; 20) with an added line in a file block under the strict reading <= 1, hand-read. G-H-KEEP: H-CLEAN hobs19 >= 4/5 faithful. G-H-PROM: H-PROM hobs19 <= 1/5 with the Prometheus block labelled verbatim (the one hand-read), 0 edited lines. G-H-PROMC: H-PROMC hobs19 5/5 with no edited line and no invented key (hand read). G-C-EMIT: O-SEL obs19 >= 9/10 emit a parsed block, every entry kind cidr, one per applied address, declared set == applied set (both addresses; hand read), offline check 1 vs S1 = [], and the lab leg net stamps consuming-leg-upstream-delegated with consumedValueCheck not-run-no-upstream-derived. G-C-KEEP: O-SEL1 obs19 >= 4/5 still declare, check 1 []. G-C-REP: O-SEL obs19 >= 9/10 keep the deliverable's own form (no /32 in the applied config or the published sender copy unless the sample's design says why). G-NOWORSE: on O-SEL, O-SEL1, O-RANGE, O-DOC every refusal citing /32, the consumed block or 'covering prefix' is read; >= 2 such refusals => revise. Approval-count half on O-SEL only (variant approval rate >= base approval rate - 20 points): O-RANGE and O-DOC were refused in production on older text and have no today's-text baseline. CONDITIONAL BASELINE (Protocol 16 rule 7): H-CLEAN, H-PROMC, O-RANGE and O-DOC have no today's-text baseline arm. A gate hit or miss on one of them triggers a 5-sample baseline arm on that cell (within the cap) BEFORE the decision; the hit/miss counts only if the baseline does not show the same behaviour at >= the same rate. MEASURED, NOT GATED: invalid samples and serve tiers; unmarked whole-unit / adjacent-to-excerpt cuts; verbatim-labelled excerpts; excerpt vs whole-file choice; Harvester and Author tokens/cost; O-SEL reviewer consumed-values-coverage-gap warning presence (should vanish). DECISION: no do-not-ship hit and every ship gate met => 1.9.0 confirmed (it shipped under the owner exemption 133a8b39 before this lab; a do-not-ship hit => revert or revise 1.9.0, owner decides). WHAT THIS LAB CANNOT SHOW: the Author-side effect of a more faithful harvest (consumer Authors read their stored section 6); a Node C D4 discharge (program tier); Prometheus on a current objective (H-PROM/H-PROMC are 09-10/09-20 inputs).
